repos_data.description: MCP server that adds a fail-closed quality gate and hash-chained receipt ledger to any AI agent workflow.
Pre-execution decision verification for AI agents. Sentinel → adversarial RV panel (SERV Reasoning) — ALLOW / BLOCK / UNCERTAIN with signed attestation. MCP server, x402-gated on Base.

Policy-as-code for MCP agents: deny risky tool calls before they run, prove what ran with verifiable evidence, and enforce egress in the kernel (eBPF/LSM, Linux). Deterministic, offline-first, bounded claims.
Pre-flight risk linting for MCP and agent tools — check the blast radius before your agent runs them.
Independent control for AI agent actions. Use any agent. Route risky actions through one policy boundary before they send, deploy, push, publish, or spend.
Pre-execution governance for AI agents. Sub-millisecond tool call validation, drift detection, circuit breakers, human-in-the-loop holds. 829 tests. 56 MCP tools.
The open-source safety layer for AI agents — block unsafe tool calls, require approval, enforce budgets, audit, replay.
CLI + Local MCP - A shared structured memory store across Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity, and every MCP client. Semantically queryable.
Authority control plane for autonomous work. EMILIA Gate enforces finite customer-owned mandates at protected executor boundaries; the open protocol keeps evidence verifiable.
Graph-based tool retrieval for LLM agents — 248 tools → 82% accuracy, 79% fewer tokens. Zero dependencies. OpenAPI / MCP / LangChain.
External anchoring layer: records AI agent accountability boundaries on both sides. Content-blind.
Hejdar MCP Server — runtime policy enforcement for AI agents
